title: Generative AI & LLM Engineer
description: Looking for an AI Engineer specializing in Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuning to build production-grade agentic and semantic AI applications.
responsibilities: Build and optimize enterprise RAG pipelines using LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Vector Databases (Pinecone/ChromaDB).
Fine-tune open-source transformer models (LLaMA, Mistral, BERT) for specialized downstream domain tasks.
Implement prompt engineering, guardrails, and evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs.
Deploy low-latency AI inference services on cloud infrastructure with Docker and FastAPI.
requirements: Strong Python coding skills with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and Sentence Transformers.
Demonstrated experience building RAG architectures and vector indexing.
Experience with prompt engineering, function calling, and agent workflows.
Familiarity with MLOps, vector databases, and containerized deployment.
